comparison.toDate: Previous period, at the same point

tooltips.comparison: “At the same point” compares like with like while the period runs: on the 17th of the month, with the 1st–17th of the previous month.
tooltips.lowerIsBetter: Shows a decrease in green, for figures you want to go down (open cases, overdue tasks…).
tooltips.dateField: The record counts in the period when this date falls in it.
tooltips.dormantDays: An open deal is listed after this many days without a recorded call, meeting or email.
tooltips.staleDays: Overdue tasks older than this leave the main list and go to “To sort out”.
tooltips.scope: Whose actions the dashlet shows when it opens. Everyone can change it in the dashlet; the choice is kept in their browser.
tooltips.showNotes: Shows the first line of each note under the name. Everyone can turn it on or off in the dashlet.
